|translation='''Title:''' It Can Wait.

'''Card text:'''
Use after the opponent just deployed a card. Spend 3 Force to return that card to the opponent’s hand. Force spent to deploy it remains used. On the opponent’s next turn, that card must be deployed to the same location if possible. Deploying it then costs no Force.

'''Lore:'''
“Captain Solo. I should tell you no, it can wait.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore names Captain Solo and completes the line; English lore is abbreviated.
